articles.title: Kalshi races to get ahead of New York order that could shut down exchange
articles.snippet: The U.S. prediction market firm asked a New York court to give the company a chance to argue against a pending restraining order stemming from a new court loss.

articles.title: Fairmint plans tokenized stock venue on Canton, Ethereum under SEC experiment
articles.snippet: The firm is the latest to join in building blockchain-based stock markets under the agency’s five-year "innovation exemption" for tokenized trading.

articles.title: Bitcoin plunges below $59,000 as rush to cash puts new bear market lows back in play
articles.snippet: Bitcoin is closing in on its $57,700 summer low as Delphi Digital strategist warns the Fed could make matters worse and STS Digital sees cash as the place to hide.

articles.title: Former Point72 head of proprietary research says AI could turn data into a new asset class for Wall Street
articles.snippet: A former Point72 executive says AI could reshape Wall Street's data market, turning once-exclusive information into a source of revenue and financing.

articles.title: U.S. Senate passes bill to ban prediction market bets on war and death
articles.snippet: The bill would ban bets on war, assassinations and military operations amid concerns that traders could profit from inside information, as has already occurred.
